chosen.title: person and dog walk among trees
chosen.why: Back view of a person walking away through trees with low-sun flare flickering through the canopy; faded, low-saturation film-like grade matches the tone. Section 8.4-11.1s carries a lens flare that sweeps in around 9.8-10.6s, giving the 'sunlight flickering through leaves' beat. Forest path rather than a paved tree-lined sidewalk, and a dog walks alongside, but no text/logo, no face, no stock-ad acting.

alternates.why: Back view of a woman walking away down a sunlit autumn forest path; steady and long, but strongly saturated yellow foliage and only 720p; would need desaturation.
Legs/feet only walking toward camera on a paved sidewalk with soft warm light; no face, but urban buildings instead of trees and some orange/graffiti color accents.

notes: Sheets tried: 'walking under trees sunlight' (0 results), 'walking park', 'walking trees', 'feet walking autumn' (0), 'walking autumn', 'feet walking', 'sun trees'. No clip of a paved tree-lined sidewalk with back view/feet and sun flicker was found; 517 is the closest in mood (film-like, low saturation, sun through trees, back view). 104 was downloaded but rejected: dark exposure and the subject turns her face to camera at ~6.5s. If a literal sidewalk is required, cream-paper fallback is acceptable.
